title: Jack Ruby as MK Ultra patient seen by Jolly West
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Jack Ruby as MK Ultra patient seen by Jolly West, about 1963-1964 at Dallas jail, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We know that Jack Ruby was an MK Ultra patient.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Jack Ruby, the Dallas nightclub owner who shot Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of killing President Kennedy, was a patient of MK Ultra, a secret CIA programme of mind-control experiments. He points to letters between a psychiatrist named Jolly West, who saw Ruby in the Dallas jail around 1963 and 1964, and Sidney Gottlieb, the CIA scientist who ran the programme. If true, it would tie the CIA's mind-control work to the Kennedy killing.
